text.description_html:
Acorn WTKBD, Old World Double Dummy Cylinder Handleset

The rough iron finish of the Old World Double Dummy Cylinder Lockset duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron; and this handleset is backed by a lifetime no rust warranty. It is perfect for traditional style homes including colonial styles and restoration projects. A dummy handleset, it is made to be used as a pull on the inactive side of double doors to match the existing trim.

Dummy Handleset: Trim for non-working doors. It does not latch and does not lock. Usually used as matching trim for the non-working side of double doors.

Also Available Matching:
Old World Single Cylinder Mortise Locket
Old World Double Cylinder Mortise Lockset

Features of the Old World Double Dummy Cylinder Lockset:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Package Includes: Interior and exterior handle, exterior and interior dummy cylinder, and all necessary mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specification for the Acorn WTKBD Old World Handleset:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Exterior and Interior Blank Cylinder Rose Length: 2-7/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Blank Cylinder Rose Width: 2-1/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Length: 10-7/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Width: 2-3/4"

Sold Individually
